sections.title: Ambulance to Hanimaadhoo Airport
sections.narration: An ambulance transferred my mother from Hanimaadhoo harbour to the airport.

sections.title: Weather delay at Hanimaadhoo Airport
sections.narration: Bad weather at Velana delayed the flight for two hours.

sections.title: Pickup walks to Vinares
sections.narration: While the aircraft is on its way, the pickup journey begins in Hulhumale.

sections.title: R9 to VIA
sections.narration: The pickup takes the R9 bus through Hulhumale and Hulhule to Velana.
